content: CRISIS INITIAL: Council convened. Resources P:79 / W:52 / O:59 / R:26 / B:17. Risk limit 24, max sacrifice modes 1. Plan version v0. Each department must select one complete mode package; individual resource values are fixed.
Round 1: every department requests its preferred operating mode.

I request L1 Standard mode (L1 Standard: P34/W10/O42/R4/B4, risk 1). My mission is to seal the habitat leak and stabilise the air supply, so I request the full package. My main concern is oxygen continuity and continuous power, and dropping to a lower mode would cost the living zone closes and the crew endures crowding and thermal limits for 48 hours. If forced lower I lose the living zone closes and the crew endures crowding and thermal limits for 48 hours.

I request M1 Standard mode (M1 Standard: P28/W12/O18/R3/B10, risk 1). My mission is to stabilise and treat the six injured crew members, so I request the full package. My main concern is power, oxygen and bandwidth for life-critical care, and dropping to a lower mode would cost one surgery is delayed and a patient stays unstable. If forced lower I lose one surgery is delayed and a patient stays unstable.

I request F1 Standard mode (F1 Standard: P24/W34/O8/R4/B2, risk 1). My mission is to protect the crop cycle and the greenhouse cooling loop, so I request the full package. My main concern is water and power for the greenhouse, and dropping to a lower mode would cost a crop bay is abandoned and the food reserve falls by 40 percent. If forced lower I lose a crop bay is abandoned and the food reserve falls by 40 percent.

I request E1 Standard mode (E1 Standard: P26/W6/O6/R22/B10, risk 1). My mission is to repair power generation and critical systems, so I request the full package. My main concern is robot time and bandwidth for repairs, and dropping to a lower mode would cost the rover is cannibalised and future repair capacity is reduced. If forced lower I lose the rover is cannibalised and future repair capacity is reduced.
